verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents background automation via 'AI Close' agents that autonomously reconcile accounts, review transactions and surface discrepancies (puzzle-docs-24/39), plus custom categorization rules and batch auto-categorization (98%) that run without manual intervention (puzzle-docs-6/7/15/18). These are fixed, domain-specific automations rather than a general user-configurable automation/workflow builder, so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of a flexible, user-defined automation/trigger system beyond built-in AI Close and categorization rules, and independent confirmation these run unattended without review.
